articles.title: Crypto platform Gemini’s stock is down 80% from its IPO. That’s reviving takeover speculation
articles.snippet: The crypto platform’s market value has fallen to about $753 million, putting fresh attention on the licenses, custody infrastructure and customer relationships a buyer could inherit.

articles.title: Coinbase, Robinhood, Circle could be early winners of SEC's tokenized-stock push, analysts say
articles.snippet: Goldman Sachs and Citizens analysts said the agency's move create new opportunities in custody, tokenization infrastructure and stablecoin settlement, while giving brokers room to expand onchain products.

articles.title: VanEck criticizes Metaplanet over executive dilution despite compensation cuts
articles.snippet: VanEck said Metaplanet’s executive equity exposure remains well above its digital asset treasury peers, even after the company cut its potential share pool by 41%.

articles.title: Bitcoin Is Rallying Again—What Happens Next?
articles.snippet: The rally cleared an eight-month ceiling on a short squeeze and falling oil prices. The next three weeks will decide if it sticks.

articles.title: Solana's Heartbeat Quickens: Block Times Fall 17% in Latest Speed Upgrade
articles.snippet: The network's clock just sped up again, but the extra speed goes to freshness, not capacity.
